searchText: sent Thanks for the help... I got validator up and launched (Prysm) and deposited 32 Eth to the deposit contract using the Ethereum Launchpad Ropsten version (thanks again). My beacon node (Prysm) is running fine and my EL (Geth) is also fully synced & running fine. Problem now is my validator appears to be stuck as the deposit is not yet recognized by the beacon chain. It's confirmed successful on the ropsten etherscan, and when I go here: https://beaconchain.ropsten.ethdevops.io/validators/eth1deposits - I see my deposit on the eth1 side with my validator public key. But I'm stuck with this in the validator: INFO validator: Waiting for deposit to be observed by beacon node pubKey=<my pub key here> status=UNKNOWN_STATUS - And Looks like is just not yet recognized on the beacon chain side here: https://beaconchain.ropsten.ethdevops.io/validators/eth2deposits . Is it just a matter of waiting it out now? Or has something gone wrong? Anything else to do but wait to be inducted? i don't think the block you made your transaction in will valid until 8 hours and also then voted upon by majority of proposers for inclusion ``` votes percent block_hash_value 247 62.53 0x65bf5926470ca9cda71fe575d4b444b26d4ab28b788daef59b3c3f51cb120cbb[566] 119 30.12 0x6def13d43cea774fe0563d006331e8f3e3a3b139bfa543321aa4516db1cc3eae[366] 15 3.797 empty[0] 11 2.784 0x0eea358b6be4634cb124e34abaf5bef7ffa95d69b5af057d3dbe7ea6db4b431d[474] 3 .7594 0x65bf5926470ca9cda71fe575d4b444b26d4ab28b788daef59b3c3f51cb120cbb[366] Cycle is 19% Complete. There are 1653 blocks remaining. ``` this means you should see inclusion of your validator in the next 12-18 hours most likely Hello I am a solo stalker and I have some general question about the test nets and the merge. https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/05/30/ropsten-merge-announcement/ advises to try out the test nets and become familiar with the upgrading process. As I am already validating on mainnet with my Geth+Lighthouse Clients, I would like to try out the upgrades on a different machine with other client instances and not touching my existing setup. Does that make sense? Or is it recommended to stop validating on the mainnet and fully transition to Ropsten? `I would like to try out the upgrades on a different machine with other client instances and not touching my existing setup` fwiw thats exactly what i'm doing. testing a minority client pair on ropsten. been hanging out and stalking 😉 over at ethstaker discord, feel free to shoot me up if you need help I can exchange Kiln for Ropsten. Is there any gentleman willing to help, thank you all sending you 65 eth now so you can get 2 validators, or 1 and send some to someone else is ACCEPTED status now deprecated in Execution Layer specs? Hive tests do not seem to have anything testing it and expect VALID instead
